tagline: Pan-European association representing inland waterway transport stakeholders including shipowners, insurers, and maritime experts
hero_kpi_rationale: The number of participants at the annual congress reflects the active engagement of the pan-European network and member commitment to association activities. This indicator measures the mobilization capacity and influence of IVR among European inland waterway transport sector players.

kpis.name: Annual congress participants
kpis.explanation: Total number of participants at the IVR annual congress, reflecting engagement and participation of European inland navigation sector members.
kpis.description: The headcount is measured by the number of participants at the May 2024 annual congress held in Frankfurt am Main from May 15-17, 2024. This indicator reflects the commitment and involvement of the pan-European network of inland waterway transport stakeholders, including shipowners, insurers, experts, port authorities, and international organizations.
kpis.signal: 225 participants at the 2024 Frankfurt annual congress, representing 11 European countries, confirming active mobilization of the network.
